errors.text: The proposed material is an Al-rich refractory B2 alloy or Al0.5CoCrFeNi, rather than the as-cast FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA.
The aging regime is given as 650–1000 K and primarily varied by time, missing the target temperature-dependent brittle window near 550–750 °C, including the 600 °C minimum and 750 °C recovery.

The central structural mediator is incorrectly assigned to ordering within a B2 matrix. The target mechanism requires enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains together with jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.

Ductility recovery through SIMT or a late-stage APBE reduction is speculative and is not established by the cited evidence. The target recovery instead involves reduced L12 ordering and ductile transition zones along phase boundaries.
The proposed experiment does not test the decisive target signature: dislocation pile-ups and crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips while excluding intergranular impurity segregation.
